answer_1.quote: We propose a framework that obfuscates stylistic features of human-generated text by automatically re-writing the text itself.
answer_1.outputs: rewritten text with obfuscated stylistic features

answer_2.quote: We feed our obfuscated test sentences to a huggingface  pre-trained GPT-2 medium model, and report its perplexity (PPL), as an automatic measure of fluency.

answer_4.quote: We design two crowd-sourcing tasks on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: For fluency, we asked: "Which sentence is more fluent in English?" For semantic consistency, we asked: "Which sentence is closer in meaning to the original sentence below?"
